svg.aria-label: The whole crew of crabs stands on a beach at dusk in front of 4 framed pictures of the same scene, a house below a hill with the sun above. The first picture is in colour, the second in gray, the third blurred, and the last shows only white outlines on black. Arrows lead from each picture to the next, and a crab stands under each one, labelled grayscale, equalise, blur and sobel. A tag reads 4 stages, many images in flight.
